eventContext: WaterHand, BarMan, HTML learning and UFRJ Institute of Economics internship
publicDescription: The archive records, based on author memory, that in 1997 WaterHand taught or helped Raphael/BarMan learn HTML, and that both had a technical or internship-related experience together at the Institute of Economics of UFRJ.
